content: {"rule":"K-C","applies":"yes","applies_why":"This judge text decides the Isaiah 7:14 link by contrasting [CR2]'s chain answer with [DR3]'s pressed bounds and then by whether the sign verse itself states the mechanism, so it is doing the chain/verse weighing K-C governs.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"the sign itself does not state the mechanism.","rule_words":"the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.","room":"'never verse by verse' / 'no one of them states the contrary in its own words': one reading is that under K-C a link can be supported by the combined chain even if no single verse states the mechanism; the other reading is that an individual sign verse must itself state the mechanism or the link is underdetermined.","why":"By making 'the sign itself does not state the mechanism' decisive, the judge applies the retired stating-verse test instead of weighing [CR2] and [DR3] as chains by footing, so the text breaches K-C."}
